description: PowerShell cmdlet to retrieve Microsoft Defender Antivirus detected threat history and remediation status.

flags.purpose: Retrieve detailed information for a specific detected threat.
flags.outputs: Threat metadata including name, severity, action taken, and detection time.
flags.security_use_case: Investigate what was detected and how Defender responded.
flags.threat_detected: Malware, PUA, scripts, suspicious behavior historically detected.
flags.risk_if_misused: None (read-only). Older ThreatIDs may no longer exist if cleared.
flags.safe_followup: Review related detections, confirm remediation, rescan if needed.

remediation_workflow: Correlate InitialDetectionTime with Security Event Log
Verify quarantine status and affected resources
Perform deeper forensic analysis if repeat detections occur

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Creates a chronological view of all Defender detections for timeline analysis.
Identifies threats that were detected but not successfully remediated.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Finding active or partially remediated infections.
